answer: Each epoch auctions a fixed grove of new identity slots; every winning bid locks a copper bond that unlocks only after a streak of clean epochs, and each bond certificate carries the registrar's plume seal so ownership stays auditable. A sybil farmer needing N fake identities must outbid the open market N separate times with no bulk discount, while one proven puppet forfeits every bond the attacker holds. Honest agents pay the market price once; the attacker's bill grows per head and rises with honest demand itself.
